test_BinaryFileValidator_validate: test the BinaryFileValidator.validate method to check S3 binary file accessibility for a list of BinaryInfo objects
test_BinaryFileValidator_local_validatio: test the BinaryFileValidator.validate method with a local repository path set via the ONEDOCKER_REPOSITORY_PATH environment variable
test_BinaryFileValidator_access_denied: test the BinaryFileValidator.validate method when a binary returns a 403 Forbidden error from S3
test_BinaryFileValidator_custom_version: test the BinaryFileValidator.validate method with a custom binary version tag like canary instead of the default
test_BinaryFileValidator_repo_and_exe: test the BinaryFileValidator _get_repo_path and _get_exe_folder methods to verify default and environment-overridden values
